verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust, Axum-backed web framework. Its documented workflow requires installing the CLI via cargo (`cargo install proa-cli`), scaffolding with `proa new site`, and compiling Rust. The emitted island JS and shared runtime are build outputs, not a script-tag distribution of the framework. Nothing in the evidence shows a CDN or script-tag way to use Proa without a package manager or build step.
